A public enum variant holding a third-party error type makes jsonwebtoken part of persona-core public API. Consequences for a downstream crate: it must depend on the exact same jsonwebtoken major version to match on or inspect the inner error, and a jsonwebtoken major bump becomes a semver-major bump of persona-core even if nothing else changes. jsonwebtoken is pre-1.0-adjacent and bumps its major regularly.

{"description":"hire-core/src/signer.rs:21-22: `#[error("jwt error: {0}")] Jwt(#[from] jsonwebtoken::errors::Error)`.

A public enum variant holding a third-party error type makes jsonwebtoken part of hire-core public API. Consequences for a downstream crate: it must depend on the exact same jsonwebtoken major version to match on or inspect the inner error, and a jsonwebtoken major bump becomes a semver-major bump of hire-core even if nothing else changes. jsonwebtoken is pre-1.0-adjacent and bumps its major regularly.

The two ring conversions are handled correctly and show the pattern to follow: signer.rs:27-37 maps `ring::error::Unspecified` and `ring::error::KeyRejected` into local `Sign(String)`/`KeyGen(String)` variants, so ring is not exposed. Do the same for jsonwebtoken — map it to a local `Jwt(String)`.

Also in this enum: `NotImplemented(String)` (signer.rs:23-24) is a public variant that exists only to describe the current X.509 stub (signer.rs:121). Removing a variant is breaking even on a `#[non_exhaustive]` enum, so shipping it commits hire-core to carrying it after the stub is filled in. `#[doc(hidden)]` on it now would keep the option open."}
